artifacts.summary: Re-derives the live title-less entry set (24, not 61) and dependency-ready wave-1 subset (17) against current specs/state.json, confirms both generator fallback chains are correct and locates where the truncated-description rendering actually occurs, flags a file_scope gap and a stale schema-doc claim, and drafts ready-to-use .title text for all 24 entries.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's state.json/TODO.md generators, generate-todo.sh's per-task heading falls back title -> project_name directly, but generate-task-order.sh's Grouped-by-Topic/Task-Order listing falls back title -> description -> project_name (description checked before project_name). A 'TODO.md shows truncated description prose instead of a title' complaint traces to the second generator's listing (embedded into TODO.md's own ## Task Order section), not the per-task heading, which already reads cleanly via project_name fallback.

A migrated task's description can carry a project-number 'priority'/'wave' list computed against the origin repo's state.json at authoring time; that list can go stale against BOTH the origin and destination repos by the time the task is dispatched (renumbering, completion, archival). Always re-derive such lists live (e.g. via generate-task-order.sh --print's dependency waves, or a fresh jq query) rather than trusting a dispatch-supplied project-number list, especially for cross-repo-migrated meta records.
